title: Change activities when scrolling over the Activity Switcher widget
line: Scrolling over the Activity Switcher widget now switches to the next or previous activity.
explanation: The Activity Switcher widget (showActivityManager) only reacted to clicks: its MouseArea had no wheel handler, so scrolling over it did nothing, unlike the pager or the Activity Bar. The change adds a wheel handler that accumulates wheel deltas in steps of 120 (respecting inverted scrolling) and switches to the next or previous activity, wrapping around. Activities follow the stable alphabetical order of the Activities.ActivityModel (the Activity Bar's order), and a fast burst of wheel steps is throttled to one switch every 300 ms towards the latest target, so no step is lost and kactivitymanagerd isn't flooded.

commits.message:
applets/showActivityManager: switch activities with the mouse wheel

Scrolling over the Activity Switcher widget did nothing. Now each wheel
step switches to the next or previous activity in alphabetical order,
like the Activity Bar, wrapping around at the ends of the list.

BUG: 506284

media.caption: Master: scrolling down and up over the widget (label "Default") does nothing.
With the fix: each wheel step down goes Default → Gaming → Work → Default, then up goes back to Work and Gaming.
